title: FLIGHT 417 - Part 1: The Same Route
notes: Qwen3-TTS. narrator + man reuse VIDEO_008 voices (narrator, unknown). Captain through the cabin PA (fx intercom).

narrator.ref_text: It was late, and the street outside was quiet. Somewhere a door closed, and I waited.

man.ref_text: Hello there. I didn't mean to scare you. I just wanted to know if anyone was still awake in there.

captain.design: Airline captain, man in his 50s, deep calm professional voice, slightly tired, speaking steadily into a cockpit microphone.
captain.ref_text: Good evening, ladies and gentlemen, this is your captain speaking. We are currently cruising at thirty-six thousand feet.

lines.text: Imagine boarding a plane that flies the same route as the plane that vanished ten years ago.
Ten years ago, Flight 417 took off just before midnight.
Over the ocean, it vanished. No wreckage. No signal. Nothing.
Tonight, you're flying the same route. Seat 14A.
The old man beside you keeps checking his watch.
"My wife was on that flight. I take this route every year."
At 2:17 AM, the cabin lights flicker. Every screen goes black.
"This is your captain. We've lost contact with the ground. Please remain seated."
You look out the window. Another plane is flying right beside you.
Old paint. No lights. And on its tail... 417.
Its windows are full of passengers. All of them are staring at you.
"That's her. That's my wife. She hasn't aged a day."
The woman lifts her hand... and points behind you.
You turn around. Half the seats on your plane are empty. The seat belts are still buckled.
"This is Flight 417. We have room for everyone."
The old man unbuckles his belt. He's smiling.
"She's waiting for me. Come with us."
Beside you, the emergency door begins to unlock by itself.
Comment A or B. Your choice decides Part 2.
